messages:
incident-bot: Paging: P0 - GPU capacity exhausted in us-west-2 causing 429s for paid tiers. Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/gpu-saturation

maya_oncall: seeing a spike of queued requests and steady 429s. Errors look like token-bucket throttle and nginx upstream 503s -> 429. Dashboard: https://console/redwood/metrics/cluster/awesomeset

sam_sre: confirmed. Autoscaler did not add GPUs, scale decision stayed at 0 -> hit pool cap. Metrics: GPU_util ~95%, queue_length rising from 20k -> 85k over 18m.

lee_runtime: logs show token bucket refill_rate was unexpectedly low for the paid tier: `tier_rate_limit[premium] = 800 rps` but token-bucket configured at 80 rps (missing multiplier). Likely config drift after config rollout at 17:40 UTC.

maya_oncall: @lee_runtime can you post the exact config diff?

lee_runtime: here's the deploy diff I saw in the rollout log: ```- tier_config.premium.refill_per_sec: 800+ -> 800
+ tokenbucket.premium.refill_per_sec: 80
``` Looks like someone mapped the wrong field.

sam_sre: that explains the 429s but not autoscaler. Why didn't autoscaler spin up?

lee_runtime: autoscaler uses request queue depth and avg latency. The token bucket throttling masked CPU/GPU load signals because many requests returned quickly with 429. The scaler's queue-length threshold is 10k but because 429 short-circuited, queue metric stayed under the trigger. Additionally, dedicated-pool max_replicas for this pool is 8 and we already at 8.

devops_bot: Alert: pool-us-west-2-gpu01 reached max_replicas=8 at 17:52:03 UTC.

maya_oncall: So two separate failures: token-bucket misconfig -> synthetic throttling, and pool cap prevented scale. Both combined caused sustained customer impact.

ops_lead: Priority: mitigate immediate customer impact. Triage plan: 1) temp increase token-bucket for premium to remove bad throttle 2) temporarily bump max_replicas for pool 3) route traffic for top enterprise customers to fallback model variant or alternate region 4) rollback bad config if rollout present.

sam_sre: I'll handle (2) and (3). Increasing max_replicas now to 12 for pool-us-west-2-gpu01. Executing: `clusterctl set pool pool-us-west-2-gpu01 --max-replicas=12`

system: clusterctl: accepted change, scale target updated.

lee_runtime: I'm patching token-bucket now to use correct field: `tokenbucket.premium.refill_per_sec=800`. Patching via k8s configmap and will restart the rate-limiter service on the edge nodes. Doing now.

maya_oncall: Customer support — which customers are seeing 429s? @customer_success please list top impacted.

customer_success: From logs and support queue: A) acme-corp (high priority) saw >500 failed requests in 20m B) beta-studio saw 2.5k 429s C) several self-serve users <100 each. Notifying acme-corp CSM and offering workaround (regional routing).

lee_runtime: Patch applied and restarted rate-limiter. Restart logs: ```2026-03-14T17:58:12Z rate-limiter version=2.4.1 start
2026-03-14T17:58:17Z tokenbucket: premium refill_per_sec=800
2026-03-14T17:58:19Z health: ok```

sam_sre: autoscaler metrics now show queue length increasing (because previously throttled requests are queued) and we've had 2 scale events. New replica count is 10/12.

devops_bot: Scale event: pool-us-west-2-gpu01 scaled from 8 -> 10 at 18:03:42 UTC.

maya_oncall: 429 rate is dropping from 14% -> 2% in last 6 minutes. Still watching.

ops_lead: Good. Next: temporary traffic routing for acme-corp -> route to us-east-1 / fallback small-model to reduce critical latency. Sam, can you confirm routing applied?

sam_sre: Applied routing override: `route-policy set acme-corp -> us-east-1,fallback-model-v2` — policy in place. They confirmed reduced error count.

customer_success: acme-corp CSM updated: they saw errors initially but now stable. They requested a postmortem and SLA credit evaluation.

maya_oncall: Will start timeline notes and assign postmortem. Immediate owner: @lee_runtime for config rollback/root cause, @sam_sre for autoscaler/pool limits. I'll hand off to night oncall @natalie_oncall in 45m.

ops_lead: Create Sev1 postmortem doc, include these sections: timeline, root cause(s), blast radius (customers affected), mitigation, short-term fixes, long-term fixes. Add action: add unit test to config validator to prevent mapping tokenbucket refills to wrong field.

lee_runtime: quick follow-up: found the rollout that introduced mapping was a hotfix merged without config schema validation. I'll revert the hotfix in the next 30m and add schema check. PR number: #2749.

sam_sre: Action items I'll own: 1) raise pool default max_replicas for paid pools from 8->16 with safety guard 2) add alert to detect token-bucket vs tier mismatch 3) update autoscaler to consider drop_rate metric (to detect synthetic 429 masking).

maya_oncall: current status: 429s mostly resolved, pool scaled to 10, token bucket fixed, routing in place for top customers. Severity will remain P1 until 24h validation and postmortem complete. Handoff to night: @natalie_oncall (not in this thread) — please pick up timeline + watch for regressions.

incident-bot: Incident update posted: https://incidents.internal/1781234567. Postmortem assigned.

ops_lead: Note for follow-up: billing/credits required, communication plan for impacted customers, and an internal blameless postmortem.

maya_oncall: Thanks all. Marking this thread as active until postmortem. :thumbsup:
